items.q: What is the difference between Immersia’s three service domains?
items.a: Integrated Impact Advisory works at the organizational level, Modular Impact Services addresses specific programs and projects, and Impact Capacity Building strengthens the capabilities of people and teams.

items.q: Can Immersia’s services be engaged as standalone assignments?
items.a: Yes. Baseline research, program design, evaluation, impact assessment, advisory support, and capacity building can be engaged as standalone assignments or combined into a connected sequence.

items.q: How does Immersia select the appropriate methodology?
items.a: Methodology is selected based on the decision question, operating context, stakeholder needs, program maturity, available evidence, data readiness, institutional capacity, and intended use of the findings.

items.q: What deliverables will our organization receive?
items.a: Deliverables depend on scope and may include research reports, frameworks, Theory of Change, indicator matrices, SOPs, dashboards, assessment tools, recommendations, facilitation materials, and capacity-building resources.

items.q: Does Immersia provide tailored in-house training?
items.a: Yes. Immersia Impact Lab provides tailored programs that can use organizational cases, existing tools, facilitated practice, mentoring, assignments, and follow-up support.

items.q: Can engagements be delivered online, offline, or in a hybrid format?
items.a: Yes. Advisory, research, facilitation, mentoring, and training can be delivered online, offline, or in a hybrid format according to the assignment and stakeholder needs.

items.q: How does Immersia support institutional capacity transfer?
items.a: Capacity transfer may include methodology handover, practical templates, SOPs, dashboards, coaching, mentoring, joint development, facilitated practice, and support for internal ownership.

items.q: What does the initial engagement process look like?
items.a: The process normally begins with a scoping discussion, followed by clarification of objectives, methodology, deliverables, stakeholders, timeline, collaboration format, and budget before a proposal is finalized.

items.q: How can our organization request a proposal?
items.a: Complete the Request Proposal form, email info@immersia.id, or contact Immersia through WhatsApp at +62 816-4603-5257. The team will follow up to clarify the scope.
